record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Suppose V is a vertex operator algebra whose central charge is 24, whose weight-1 subspace is zero, and whose irreducible V-modules are all equivalent to V while every V-module is completely reducible. Must V be isomorphic to the moonshine module vertex operator algebra?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 7.1. Let V be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the following three conditions: (1) The central charge of V is 24.

(2) V has no nonzero elements of weight 1. (3) Any irreducible V module is equivalent to V as a V -module and every V -module is completely reducible. Then V must be isomorphic to the moonshine module vertex operator algebra.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let V = ⊕_{n≥0} V_n be a vertex operator algebra over the complex numbers, graded by conformal weight, with vacuum vector and Virasoro element whose central charge equals 24. Assume:

(1) The weight-one subspace V_1 is zero.
(2) Every irreducible V-module is isomorphic to V itself (i.e., V is holomorphic / self-dual as a module over itself).
(3) Every V-module is completely reducible (i.e., V is rational).

Must V be isomorphic, as a vertex operator algebra, to the moonshine module V^♮ constructed by Frenkel–Lepowsky–Meurman (the unique known holomorphic VOA of central charge 24 with vanishing weight-one space, whose graded character is j(τ) − 744 and whose automorphism group is the Monster simple group)?
artifact.status_search_result: The uniqueness of the moonshine module among holomorphic c=24 vertex operator algebras with trivial weight-one space is the long-standing FLM uniqueness conjecture. Partial results exist (e.g., uniqueness under the additional assumption that V is a framed VOA, due to Dong–Griess and others; classification of the 70 holomorphic c=24 VOAs with nontrivial V_1 via the Schellekens list and recent works on automorphism groups), but the general conjecture remains open as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism Groups and Uniqueness of Holomorphic Vertex Operator Algebras of Central Charge 24
status_evidence.snippet: Uniqueness established for the 70 holomorphic c=24 VOAs with nontrivial weight-one Lie algebra; the V_1=0 case (moonshine module) remains the open case.
status_evidence.claim: The remaining (V_1 = 0) case is the moonshine module, whose uniqueness is still open.

status_evidence.title: On the uniqueness of the moonshine vertex operator algebra (Dong–Griess)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves uniqueness under the additional hypothesis that V is a framed vertex operator algebra.
status_evidence.claim: Partial result: uniqueness holds for framed VOAs satisfying the hypotheses.
